name: Soccer Arena [Beta]
desc:
⚽ Soccer Arena is a soccer-based PVP game. Aim the corner, charge your foot, and kick a finishing goal!  Or use your ability to turn the tables —— It's all about strategy and techniques.

🎮How to play:
KICK - Left Click
CHARGE KICK - Left Click (Hold)
JUMP KICK - Left Click (In air)
DASH - Q
Ability - E (energy full)
